name: Fantastic Coming Soon Landing Page
headline: Fantastic Coming Soon: Landing Page Script
short_description: Fantastic Coming Soon is a PHP / MySQL script for a coming soon landing page with all the marketing tools to start your website promotion : newsletter registration, contact form, access map, content, SEO, google analytics, multilingual. Easy and fast install and configuration.
author: Agence-Tandem

sections.overview:
Fantastic Coming Soon is a PHP/MySQL script that deploys a responsive coming soon landing page with built-in marketing tools. It includes newsletter subscription management, a contact form, countdown timer, progress bar, Google Maps integration, and full SEO controls for title and meta descriptions. The script supports multiple languages with automatic visitor language detection and offers a complete admin dashboard for managing subscribers and exporting data. Installation is straightforward through configuration files, and the tool integrates Google Analytics and Font Awesome icons for a professional appearance.
Launch a coming soon page while developing a website
Collect email subscribers before official product launch
Promote a website launch across multiple language markets
Display location and contact information during pre-launch phase
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Agence-Tandem/fantastic-coming-soon-landing-page`
sections.usage:
```
Create a coming soon landing page for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Include a newsletter registration form, contact form, access map, and multilingual support. Ensure it is SEO-optimized and ready for Google Analytics integration. The design should be modern and visually appealing.
```
